field.title: SPHEREx DR1 · field around Barnard's Star (GJ 699)
field.centre_note: Field centre = approximate position of Barnard's Star for 2025.9 (published astrometry propagated by hand), used only to centre the archive query and cutouts. SkyShift has not identified, matched or measured any source in these images; Gaia DR3 matching is a later step.
field.purpose: First real-image viewer field: chosen because a live DR1 discovery query found 239 Spectral Images containing this position, in two observing seasons (Aug-Sep 2025, Mar-May 2026), on all six detectors, one processing version (v27) and no duplicate products.
